title: Soulflow Engine
wikitext:
{{Minion Upgrade |rarity = e |slayer_level_requirement = Enderman Slayer 5 |obtain = [[Crafting]] |function = Reduces the minion's output by {{Red|50%}}, but it will start generating {{Aqua|Soulflow}} items.

While equipped on a Voidling minion, output is increased by {{Purple|3%}} per minion level. |upgrades_from = Lesser Soulflow Engine |salable = f |auctionable = n |raw_materials = *11264 Null Sphere *450560 Obsidian *61440 Ender Pearl *6144 Blaze Rod *819200 Iron Ingot *2 Null Atom *30720 Titanium |mat_cost_bazaar = *88 Null Ovoid *192 Enchanted Eye of Ender *32 Enchanted Iron Block *2 Null Atom *12 Refined Titanium |bazaar = Soulflow Engine |id = SOULFLOW_ENGINE }} The '''Soulflow Engine''' is an {{Epic}} [[Minion Upgrade]] that is unlocked at {{Coll|Enderman Slayer 5}}. It sacrifices [[Minions|minion]] output for {{Stat|Soulflow}} item generation. If it is added to a {{Item|Voidling Minion}}, the {{Item|Raw Soulflow}} output will increase by 3% per minion tier. == Obtaining == === Crafting === {{Crafting Recipe Table |{{Crafting Recipe Row |requirement = {{Coll|Enderman Slayer 5}} |A1 = Null Atom |B1 = Lesser Soulflow Engine |C1 = Null Atom |A2 = Lesser Soulflow Engine |B2 = Null Ovoid, 64 |C2 = Lesser Soulflow Engine |A3 = Refined Titanium, 6 |B3 = Lesser Soulflow Engine |C3 = Refined Titanium, 6 |Output = Soulflow Engine }} }} == Usage == === Minion Upgrade === The '''Soulflow Engine''' requires {{Coll|Enderman Slayer 5|img = t}} to use. {{Affected Minions List|upgrade|all}} When it is added to a minion, the minion's output will be reduced by 50%, but the minion will produce {{Item|Raw Soulflow|amount=1}} every {{Green|90}} seconds when player is on the island and every {{Green|105}} seconds when not. If it is added to a {{Item|Voidling Minion}}, the {{Item|Raw Soulflow}} output will increase by {{Green|3%}} per minion tier. The {{Item|Raw Soulflow}} production cooldown isn't affected by minion speed modifiers. Drop multiplier [[Minion Fuel]]s (like {{Item|Hyper Catalyst}}) do increase the amount of {{Item|Raw Soulflow}} made, including the extra {{Item|Raw Soulflow}} from the boost of {{Item|Voidling Minion}}. Purple particles will appear above minions with a '''Soulflow Engine'''. == Expected Profits == The following is the expected revenue from 1 minion with a '''Soulflow Engine''', based on the current {{NPCSprite|Bazaar}} prices for {{Item|Soulflow (Item)|text=Soulflow}} and {{Item|Raw Soulflow}}. {| class="wikitable centertext" |- !{{Item|Super Compactor 3000}} !1 hour !24 hours |- |{{No}} |{{BazaarPurchaseCalc|40 RAW_SOULFLOW}} |{{BazaarPurchaseCalc|960 RAW_SOULFLOW}} |- |{{Yes}} |{{BazaarPurchaseCalc|0.2 SOULFLOW}} |{{BazaarPurchaseCalc|5 SOULFLOW}} |} == Trivia == * Minions will wait until the next production cycle to generate {{Item|Raw Soulflow}} if the player is on the island. * A single minion cannot use 2 Soulflow Engines at the same time. * This item produces {{Item|Raw Soulflow}} in about 2x speed of the {{ID|Lesser Soulflow Engine{{!}}previous tier}}. * If a minion with a {{Item|Budget Hopper}} or {{Item|Enchanted Hopper}} is full while holding a Soulflow Engine, the produced {{Item|Raw Soulflow}} will be deleted.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HnvfMx-xfx0&t=503s * If the '''Soulflow Engine''' is used for purely getting soulflow, a good choice for minion to use with the upgrade is {{Item|Voidling Minion}} or a minion that does not fill their storage quickly with their own drops. This leaves more room for soulflow instead. For example: ** {{Item|Inferno Minion}}, which is the slowest minion in the game if not given [[Inferno Minion Fuel]]; ** {{Item|Vampire Minion}}, which is the second slowest minion in the game; ** A {{Item|Super Compactor 3000}} with any slow minion whose drops have a second compacted form, e.g. {{Item|Emerald Minion}}, {{Item|Quartz Minion}}, {{Item|Blaze Minion}}. * If the produced soulflow is used for profit, it is better to use a minion that already makes good profit by itself. == History == {{History table |beta= {{History|2021/May 31|[[File:Soulflow Engine.png|26px]] Added '''Soulflow Engine'''.}} {{History|0.18.3|Added '''Soulflow Engine''' to the [[Bazaar]].}} }} == References == == Navigation == {{Nav/Minion Modifiers}} {{Nav/Slayer/Enderman}}
